properties.name: serde_yaml → serde_yaml_ng 0.10; Cargo.lock refreshed within declared ranges (82 crates; rmcp 3.3.0 and rocksdb unchanged)
properties.rationale: dec:serde-yaml-is-replaced-by-serde-yaml-ng-and-the-lock-is-refreshed, Anthony's word 2026-09-14. A build never upgrades anything (Cargo.lock pins), so the deprecated crate would have stayed forever; a rename-not-rewrite fork keeps the change to three lines. Verified on the new lock: core suite in-memory, server suite, clippy both crates, format, wire instruments.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: The YAML reader that parses reflow2's schema moved from the archived serde_yaml 0.9.34+deprecated to its maintained same-API fork serde_yaml_ng 0.10 (workspace Cargo.toml, reflow2-core Cargo.toml, two use sites in foundation/core/schema.rs and foundation/mod.rs), and cargo update moved 82 crates to the newest versions their declared ranges already allowed. No behaviour change; rocksdb/librocksdb-sys deliberately untouched.
